text: Design decision: enrich AtlasQuotient as the atlas realization adapter rather than adding a second Domain or Parcellation abstraction. Parcel FiniteSpace identity will use a full versioned ordered stable-key preimage; metadata and display order remain indexed annotations. Volume support projects the exact image4s GridDomain record. Bilateral surface support commits to coordinate-space id, hemisphere order, vertex counts, and every ordered face index, with left-then-right assignment segments. Neuropublish projection will expose primitive neutral records plus fixed v1 binary identity and i32le assignment assets, not a Scala-derived codec. Exact persistent alignment is the default; arbitrary same-sized targets require a caller-supplied locus4s Bijection.
